第十九章 梦幻开局
感谢书友“我对本书读后感”的再次打赏，继续求推荐票和会员点击^_^
由于得到两位名将的加盟，又有经验丰富的徐根保掌舵，初建不久的东方队受到了媒体的普遍看好，可是到了2003年中国足球乙级联赛开始前夕，徐根保才发现一个非常严重的问题，世少赛的赛程与乙级联赛撞车了，2003年的乙级联赛第一阶段在7月12日至8月13日举行，而世少赛则在这一年的8月开幕，按照中国足球国字号长期集训的传统，至少也得提前一个月开始集训，也就是说入选国少队的东方队球员将会全部缺席乙级联赛的第一阶段，而现在东方队入选国少的人数已经远不止当初的三个了......
经过亚少赛最后两场比赛和其后一些热身赛中出色的表现，高军已经坐稳了国少队主力前锋的位置并成为了全队的进攻核心，因此主教练对他推荐的那些队员也较为重视，很快容昊就靠着自己过人的速度盘带和老年老成的心理素质，成为了国少队不可或缺的主力球员，而门将曾城与更加年轻的张林鹏也在高军的力荐下勉强挤进了国少队的大名单。
这样一来，东方队入选国少队的总人数就骤增到了6人之多，其中除了曾城之外，全都是东方队不可或缺的主力，一下子主力阵容跑掉了一半，那些年纪才十四五岁、甚至更小的替补们能够帮助球队闯过乙级联赛第一阶段华东区预赛这一关吗？即使是向来自信的徐根保与队长范将军都没有多大的信心......
好在徐根保在中国足坛还有几分薄面，经过他与国少队教练组的交涉，国少队同意那5个东方队的主力队员可以推迟到世少赛开幕前两个星期的时候来国少队报道，这样他们就来得及代表东方队把乙级联赛一开始的几场比赛踢了，多拿点积分打下好的基础，即使不足以提前获得晋级资格，至少也能给替补们减轻一点压力。
为此高军也没心思保存实力了，他在第一场比赛中就上演了帽子戏法，帮助球队3：0横扫华东赛区最强的敌手广州日之泉亿达队，其后又来了一个大四喜，将实力不俗的广东名峰队4：0血洗，由于一个人包揽了全队所有的进球，高军很快就得到了他这一世的第一个绰号——“球场黑洞”，意思是他有好机会时肯定选择自己射门，球给了他就出不来了......
但却无人会因此指责高军，因为他攻进这7个球只用掉了10次射门机会，甚至没进的那三次都打在门柱上（其中一次由他自己补进），没有一次射门完全偏出，甚至连被守门员扑到的都没有，这样恐怖的高效率下，不传球或许才是正确的选择......
最终在中乙联赛第一阶段的前四场比赛中，高军一人独进12球，占到了全队进球数的80%，豪取四连胜的东方队也有了足够的底气撑过接下来主力离队的艰难时期，等待参加世少赛的主力队员们王者归来......
之所以能在乙级联赛这样的成年比赛中表现也如此出色，除了高军超阶的技术和意识，也因为他的身体素质又有了明显的提升。由于科化足球理念下一系列营养与训练方案的巨大帮助，再加上进入青春期以后的加速发育，2003年参加乙级联赛时即将年满15周岁的高军已经有差不多1米6的个子和不下105斤的体重，与他刚进崇明基地时的模样对比，让人不得不感叹这三年多来按照科化足球理念补充营养和科学训练所取得的成效之大。
由于身高和肌肉的迅速增长，高军的速度和爆发力也有了惊人的提高，如今他的百米最好成绩已经跑进了11秒7（手计时），而4×10米折返跑成绩更是跃居队内第一，甚至超过了当年爆发力在国内、乃至整个亚洲都罕有人及的范将军和百米速度全队第一的余海，这足以说明高军的瞬间爆发力和身体的灵活性有多么出色。
而在比赛中，由于高军那快得匪夷所思的反应速度和精准得宛如超级计算机的球路预判，使得他的启动奇快无比而且时机恰到好处，对于距离十米以内的皮球，在身位平行时，轻易就能摆脱队内任何一位球员的盯防抢到第一点，连范将军也感叹说，目前国内在这方面能够超过高军的，大概也只有郝大炮了，而且优势并不明显。以高军的年纪，将来还有很大的上升空间，他会成长到何种程度，真是令人期待......
此外，高军的弹跳能力也有了大幅度的增长，如今他的原地起跳单手摸高在队内排名前十，而身高1米65以下的队员当中则无一人可以与他比肩，再加上高军那罕有人及的落点预判，在比赛中的表现只会更好，尽管即使如此，目前只有1米60的小个子还是当不了空霸的......
虽然至今还未开始进行大强度的力量训练，但科化足球对于肌肉的发育依然很有帮助，如今高军的力量早已不再是全队倒数，而且因为平衡性极其出色的缘故，令其可以在体重超过自己二十斤的队友逼抢下完成各种基本的技术动作。当然前提是对方不犯规，但在正规比赛中，这却是难以避免的，因此高军暂时还是尽量不拿球不带球，以抢点射门作为主要的攻击手段。
有了自己的变化作为例证后，自称这些知识都是这两三年里自学的高军说服徐根保的难度自然下降了许多，而且参加乙级联赛之后俱乐部多少有了点收入，因此至少酱油的问题总算是解决了，另外对于进入青春期的年龄组，食堂也全面使用蚝油取代了味精。以崇明基地或者说是东方俱乐部现在的财力，暂时也只能做到这么多了，或许能够冲上甲B的话可以有更多的门票收入和赞助，那时再全面推行这些措施......
到国少队报到后，高军意外地发现毛建卿居然把主力位置丢了，原来这个不自律的家伙半年来状态下降得很厉害，而两位替补前锋、尤其是特点与毛建卿十分类似的江晨则有了明显的进步，刘春铭再怎么平庸，也知道如何选择，话说回来，他差的也只是业务水平，要说眼光和做人，那可都厉害着呢，要不然历史上他也不会当了好几届国青国少的主帅，而且球员们对他的评价还都不错......
不过身为穿越者的高军却知道这个江晨最后的发展甚至连小毛都不如，至于原因是年龄改得更狠、还是那违纪不断的性格，他毕竟没有带过这小子，所以也并不清楚。相对而言，高军更看好虽然是玻璃人但是更具灵气的替补前锋江宁，可是没有合理的理由，他根本说服不了主教练，毕竟他并不是真的马拉多纳。但这时的高军却不清楚，历史上江晨在这届世少赛上的状态热得发烫......
content_en:
Chapter 19 Dream Beginning
Thank you to the book friend for your "My Thoughts on Reading this Book" review again. Please continue to ask for recommendation votes and member clicks ^_^
Due to the joining of two famous players and the experienced Xu Genbao at the helm, the newly established Oriental team was generally favored by the media. However, on the eve of the start of the Chinese Football League Second League in 2003, Xu Genbao discovered a very serious problem. The schedule of the World Junior Championship collided with the Second League. The first stage of the 2003 Second League was held on July 12 It will be held from August 1 to August 13, and the World Junior Championship will open in August of this year. According to the long-term training tradition of Chinese football national football team, the training must start at least one month in advance. This means that all the players of the Oriental team selected for the national junior team will miss the first stage of the second division league. Now, the number of players selected for the Oriental team for the national junior team is far more than the original three...
After the last two games of the Asian Youth Championship and the outstanding performance in some subsequent warm-up matches, Gao Jun has firmly established himself as the main forward of the National Youth Team and has become the core of the team's offense. Therefore, the head coach also attaches great importance to the players he recommended. Kua Ronghao relied on his extraordinary dribbling speed and mature psychological quality to become an indispensable main player of the national junior team. Goalkeeper Zeng Cheng and the younger Zhang Linpeng also reluctantly squeezed into the national junior team's roster under Gao Jun's recommendation.
As a result, the total number of members of the Oriental team selected for the national junior team suddenly increased to 6. Among them, except for Zeng Cheng, they were all indispensable main players of the Oriental team. Suddenly, half of the main lineup was gone. Can those substitutes who are only 14 or 15 years old or even younger help the team pass the first stage of the East China District preliminaries of the Second Division League? Even the always confident Xu Genbao and captain General Fan don’t have much confidence...
Fortunately, Xu Genbao is still a bit weak in Chinese football. After negotiations with the coaching staff of the National Junior Team, the National Junior Team agreed that the five main players of the Oriental Team can postpone reporting to the National Junior Team until two weeks before the opening of the World Junior Championships. This way, they will have time to play the first few games of the Second Division League on behalf of the Oriental Team, gain more points and lay a good foundation. Even if it is not enough to qualify for promotion in advance, it can at least relieve some pressure on the substitutes.
For this reason, Gao Jun had no intention of preserving his strength. He performed a hat trick in the first game, helping the team sweep the strongest opponent in the East China Division, Guangzhou Rizhiquan Yida Team, 3:0. Later, another big four came, beating the powerful Guangdong Mingfeng Team by 4. :0 bloodbath, because one person scored all the team's goals, Gao Jun soon got his first nickname in this life-"The Black Hole of the Stadium", which means that when he has a good opportunity, he will definitely choose to shoot by himself, and the ball will not come out if it is given to him...
But no one would blame Gao Jun for this, because he only used 10 shooting opportunities to score these 7 goals, and even the three missed shots hit the goal post (one of which was made up by himself). None of the shots missed completely, and none were even saved by the goalkeeper. With such a terrifyingly high efficiency, not passing the ball may be the right choice...
In the end, in the first four games of the first stage of the Chinese League Two, Gao Jun scored 12 goals alone, accounting for 80% of the team's goals. The Oriental team, which had won four consecutive victories, also had enough confidence to survive the difficult period when the main players left the team. They are waiting for the return of the main players who participated in the World Junior Championship...
The reason why he can perform so well in adult competitions such as the Second Division League is not only Gao Jun's super-level skills and consciousness, but also because his physical fitness has been significantly improved. Due to the huge help of a series of nutrition and training programs under the Kehua Football Concept, coupled with the accelerated development after entering puberty, he was about to join the Second Division League in 2003.Gao Jun, who is 15 years old, is almost 1.6 meters tall and weighs no less than 105 kilograms. Compared with his appearance when he first entered the Chongming base, one has to marvel at the great results achieved by supplementing nutrition and scientific training in accordance with the scientific football concept over the past three years.
Due to the rapid growth of his height and muscles, Gao Jun's speed and explosive power have also improved astonishingly. Now his best time for 100 meters has been 11.7 seconds (hand time), and his 4×10 meter turnaround time has ranked first in the team, even surpassing General Fan, whose explosive power was rarely matched in China and even in Asia.
And in the game, because of Gao Jun's incredibly fast reaction speed and his prediction of the ball path as accurate as a super computer, his start is extremely fast and the timing is perfect. For the ball within ten meters away, when he is parallel, he can easily get rid of the marking of any player in the team and grab the first point. Even General Fan lamented that at present, the only player in China who can surpass Gao Jun in this aspect is probably Hao Dapao, and the advantage is not obvious. At Gao Jun's age, there is still a lot of room for improvement in the future. It is really exciting to see how far he will grow...
In addition, Gao Jun's jumping ability has also increased significantly. Now his one-handed reach when jumping on the spot ranks in the top ten in the team, and no one among the players under 1.65 meters tall can match him. Coupled with Gao Jun's rare prediction of landing point, his performance in the game will only be better. Even so, the current little man who is only 1.60 meters still cannot be an aerial master...
Although high-intensity strength training has not yet begun, Kehua football is still very helpful for muscle development. Now Gao Jun's strength is no longer the lowest in the team, and because of his excellent balance, he can complete various basic technical movements under pressure from teammates who weigh more than 20 kilograms. Of course, the premise is that the opponent does not foul, but in regular games, this is unavoidable. Therefore, Gao Jun still tries not to take the ball or dribble for the time being, and uses grabbing points and shooting as the main means of attack.
With his own changes as an example, Gao Jun, who claimed that he had learned all this knowledge on his own in the past two or three years, naturally found it much easier to convince Xu Genbao. Moreover, the club had some income after participating in the second division league, so at least the soy sauce problem was finally solved. In addition, for the age group entering adolescence, the canteen also uses oyster sauce instead of MSG. With the current financial resources of Chongming Base or Oriental Club, they can only do so much for the time being. Perhaps if they can reach Class A and B, they can get more ticket revenue and sponsorship, and then we can fully implement these measures...
After reporting to the national youth team, Gao Jun unexpectedly discovered that Mao Jianqing had lost his main position. It turned out that this unself-disciplined guy had declined significantly in the past six months, while the two substitute forwards, especially Jiang Chen, whose characteristics were very similar to Mao Jianqing, had made significant progress. Liu Chunming again No matter how mediocre he is, he also knows how to choose. Having said that, the only thing he lacks is his professional level. In terms of vision and conduct, he is very good. Otherwise, he would not have been the coach of several national youth and national youth teams in history, and the players rated him well...
However, as a time traveler, Gao Jun knew that Jiang Chen's final development was not even as good as Xiao Mao's. As for whether the reason was a more severe age change or a character that constantly violated disciplines, he had never taken care of this kid before, so he didn't know. Relatively speaking, Gao Jun is more optimistic about the substitute forward Jiang Ning, who is a glass man but has more aura. However, without reasonable reasons, he cannot convince the head coach at all. After all, he is notReally Maradona. But at this time, Gao Jun didn't know that Jiang Chen's state in this World Junior Championship was extremely hot...
